00:06.000-00:07.250 stirring under heavy blur. The count and colors swing from frame to frame (several yellows, a few reds and greens)
00:07.500-00:08.750 bowl A is mostly red and green: at least 4-5 distinct reds and 3-4 greens, with only 1-2 yellows
00:09.000-00:09.750 (frame 39, full res) bowl A shows about 5-6 red balls, 1 green and 1 yellow. Frame 40 shows about 5 reds, 2 greens and 1 yellow

Neither hand removes a ball, nothing goes over the rim or onto the table, and the small hand cannot be covering 4 balls in the clear glass bowl, so about 4 balls vanish.

findings.invariant_violated: conservation / source contents (balls appear and change color)
findings.description: Early on the bowl holds about 3 red, 3 green and 3 yellow balls (00:02 full-resolution frame). Between 00:07.5 and 00:09.75 it shows about 5-6 red balls but only about 1 yellow (00:09.5: ~6 red, 1 green, 1 yellow). No red ball is added from outside (the table reds stay where they were and the hand never leaves the bowl), and no yellow ball is taken out. Reds appear from nowhere while yellows disappear, so the contents change kind with no transfer to explain it.
